replicate_statements: Mean fluorescence intensity (gray values) quantified in ImageJ from 8-bit grayscale images of cells of the indicated strains.

Exact p values and biological replicate numbers presented in this figure are reported in Table EV6.
outputs.explanation: The unit of replication (individual cells) is named, but no numeric count of cells or of underlying biological replicates is given in the legend; the exact numbers are only said to be in Table EV6, not shown here.
